description: Two-bot head-on collision: bot-A walks +Z and bot-B walks -Z on a shared 4x4 platform until both stabilize blocked.
geometry: scenario-collision map — 4x4 colored_block_blue platform (voxel cols x={0,4,8,12}, z={0,4,8,12}); platform world X: 0–8m, Z: 0–8m, top face at world Y=2m

spawnPoints.description: Bot-A start — near-Z end, walks in +Z direction
Bot-B start — far-Z end, walks in -Z direction

keyframes.captureCondition: bot-A.pos.z > 2 and bot-B.pos.z < 6 (both moving toward each other, gap > 1m)
keyframes.description: Both bots walking toward each other, approaching but not yet blocked

keyframes.captureCondition: |bot-A.pos.z delta over 1s| < 0.05 and |bot-B.pos.z delta over 1s| < 0.05 (both stabilized)
keyframes.description: Both bots stabilized blocked face-to-face; vel.x ≈ 0 and vel.z ≈ 0 for both
